message:
Ports come up in every troubleshooting session, so here is a matching check.

```quiz
{"mode":"practice","questions":[{"type":"match","question":"Match each well-known port to its protocol.","pairs":[["22","SSH"],["53","DNS"],["443","HTTPS"],["161","SNMP"]],"extra":["Telnet"],"explanation":"Telnet (23) is the extra choice: it has no pair here."},{"question":"Which protocol resolves an IPv4 address to a MAC address on the local segment?","options":["ARP","DNS","DHCP","ICMP"],"answer":"A","explanation":"ARP maps a next-hop IPv4 address to the hardware address that frames are sent to."}]}
```
